verdict.rationale: Luma documents reusable automations through Luma Skills ('Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever') and Luma Agents for multi-step workflows, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those workflows. Reusable workflows are an adjacent capability and do not count as version control or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
